Review Text: staff’s attitude wasn’t friendly and kind of rude
Six stars review…

I bought three green lattes, but they had neither green tea nor fresh milk flavor; they tasted worse than boiled water—absolutely awful. I will never buy from them again! I will refuse to do business with them again.

I usually buy from the stores near me, but recently I've been patronizing your store. The Ovaltine flavor has been quite weak at these stores, so I compared prices at three different stores. They all have 5+5 (creamer + Ovaltine), while your store only has 4+4 (creamer + Ovaltine). I'm wondering if this is an accidental mistake each time, or if it's a policy of the store?

The delivery time initially confirmed with the restaurant was 3:00–3:30. To avoid any misunderstanding, I proactively called again at 14:50 to confirm, only to receive a clearly impatient reply: "Wasn't it 3:00–3:30 for delivery?" Although the attitude was surprising, I still chose to respect their schedule. However, by 3:27, the delivery still hadn't arrived, so I called again. The woman who answered initially didn't answer for a long time, only repeatedly asking others, before finally changing her story and saying, "We scheduled it for 3:30–4:00." The information provided was completely contradictory, and there was no explanation or apology. This isn't a matter of being busy; it's a lack of basic communication, responsibility, and integrity. The whole process didn't just feel negligence, but rather "indifference." From a consumer's perspective, I just want to say: if even the most basic time commitments and responses can't be fulfilled, then one can't expect anything else to be done well. This experience was very disappointing, and it made me realize that I will not choose this place again in the future.

I bought a hot drink and it was securely placed in the motorcycle compartment. When I opened it, I found the entire paper cup was cracked. It seemed like the glue hadn't been properly applied. When I told the store, they just said it's normal for it to crack if it gets hit by a motorcycle?

Trying the new product today: Light Lemon Yogurt Green. It's sweet but not cloying, a taste of summer. A short-haired female staff member was also very friendly, recommending the perfect ratio of sugar to ice. A delicious and thoughtfully prepared product; thank you to the staff for their hard work! 👍
Now that you've opened a delivery platform, can't you at least respect delivery orders? All the in-store orders have been processed, but the delivery orders are still dragging on.

The "Zhenbo Coconut Tea" had no pearls, no tapioca pearls, no coconut jelly—no toppings whatsoever—and it cost 45 yuan! If they had a lot of orders and forgot to add toppings, that would be understandable. There weren't many people when I ordered, and the food arrived in less than a minute. Couldn't they have checked more carefully? I can only give it six stars, no more than that.
Normally one drink is fine, but I just ordered six in one go! And there wasn't even a straw… How am I supposed to drink them…?

If a store clerk provides uniformly unfriendly service, that's somewhat acceptable. However, today my friend and I went to your store to buy drinks, both of us ordering four. When we got to the back, a female customer softened her voice and proactively asked if we wanted to combine our order with a "buy five get one free" offer, providing friendly service. Then, when we asked again if we could combine it to five drinks, her unfriendly and impatient attitude reverted. My friend was amazed by how quickly she changed her attitude. It's true! You're not entitled to pay, but since she proactively asked, shouldn't she treat everyone equally? If she accidentally missed asking, shouldn't she at least be more friendly afterward? Otherwise, why maintain the same unfriendly and impatient attitude from the start of the workday until the end, letting everyone know that this is your store's characteristic?

It's understandable that you're busy with many customers, but what's the point of giving customers a sour look and rolling your eyes when they can't hear you, especially when they speak in hushed tones? Please educate your staff on their service attitude.
Despite having only two staff members, the operation proceeded smoothly, efficiently, and at a steady pace, with a steady flow of people.

The male clerk at the counter seemed to be new; he accidentally made a mistake with a drink, but he fixed it quickly. I wanted to remind him that he could wipe the cup after making the drink, as it was quite busy and mistakes might happen. However, his attitude was very good and he was very proactive. The drink I received was fine; the taste wasn't too strong or too weak. I'll give him five stars as encouragement. I hope he can become more familiar with the store's operations in the future. Keep it up! 💪🏻

I came here specifically for the light lemon yogurt. The staff kindly said it tastes better with full sugar if it's your first time trying it. I usually prefer sour drinks, so I ordered half sugar, and it was delicious even with half sugar! 😍😍😍 I also ordered the green tea today; I hope other stores will follow suit. It's so delicious!
Business is booming, lots of orders! The staff are very efficient. The oatmeal and No. 1 drink are delicious.

The guy at the front desk today who dyed his hair had terrible service. He was rude and impatient with customers. When I got home and drank my beverage, I found a mosquito in it... I was so angry at him for taking it out on me, and he even gave me a cup of mosquito-infested tea. Thank you so much! I will never go there again.

I don't even want to give it one star. The female staff member had an extremely bad attitude. If we hadn't left quickly, this 50 Lan store would have been ruined. I will absolutely never go there again. They said there was no tear, but there was a hole in the cup. The hot water turned to room temperature. The tapioca pearls were soaked for too long. The milk tea was tasteless, like water. Please, if you don't want to give us freebies next time, don't do it. Don't deliberately mess with us.
Even with a midday heat of 38 degrees Celsius, the urge to buy a drink still couldn't be stopped! 😆 Drinking it helped cool me down.

I ordered a hot meal, but it arrived cold. The delivery person should have been on their way in less than 5 minutes. I ordered hot, not lukewarm, so it shouldn't have arrived cold. The restaurant's attitude was extremely poor and they didn't handle the situation. Panda (the delivery company) also didn't address the issue.
Isn't this a bit much? Was it even filled to the brim? This is such a terrible shop. Could the manager please find some better staff? Selling drinks to customers when they're not even fully filled?

Six-star review! First time buying bubble tea without pearls, probably because the staff didn't have time to go to Nanliao to collect them. So disappointing! (Also, the bubble tea was super thin and weak…)

I visited the store around 6:50 PM on May 8, 2025. During the visit, I encountered a staff member whose attitude was unfriendly and whose communication style was rather aggressive, making me feel uncomfortable. I hope the store can strengthen its employee emotional management and service training to provide customers with a better shopping experience.
The two waitresses that day were very friendly and attentive 👍 I was a little surprised that their service was different from what I'd seen in the reviews! …
Something unknown appeared in the bubble tea latte I bought today... (tea leaves?)

I ordered delivery from outside the store, confirming the number of cups and delivery time the day before. Today, when I called to confirm the items, the staff's attitude really could be improved. I had noted the delivery time as 11:40-11:50 the day before, but he kept telling me he couldn't guarantee the time and could only arrive before 12:00. He couldn't guarantee what might happen to the delivery driver on the way. So, is it not acceptable to order delivery with a delayed delivery time? Also, he kept asking why I didn't order from a closer store. If the distance is unacceptable, why accept the order in the first place? Besides, I had already ordered before, so the distance wasn't an issue. Please improve your staff training. Thank you.

 When I asked again after that time, they said it would take another 10 minutes
 They're clearly short-staffed but keep taking delivery orders
 Of all the beverage shops on Guangfu Road, yours is the slowest
